objective: Offline actual-model mixed prefill + full DFlash target verification correctness
source_base: 986d789766 plus frozen prior throughput experiment source
method: One prefill request plus three complete block8 verify requests; one anchor and seven speculative positions each.
Native draft graph produces proposals. Native verify graph, separate eager and mixed eager receive identical candidates per case.
Each comparison restores the same pre-verify target/draft KV, Conv/SSM, ReplaySSM and request mappings; acceptance is computed by native _accept_block.
Floating state reference is separate eager; native graph comparison checks acceptance/bonus rather than an independent full-state equality assertion.
Natural lane preserves proposals; rejection fixture changes two candidate IDs, never forces accepted lengths.
Across cases the unmodified native path advances D and the next P chunk once. Mixed state is not chained as an independent 9-round trajectory.
Snapshots check all Conv/SSM and ReplaySSM tensors; target/draft KV coverage includes all locations allocated to these requests plus sentinel zero, not every unallocated GPU page.
Frozen-intermediate lane substitutes separate-eager token-local projection/MoE outputs into mixed execution solely to isolate state routing; it cannot qualify graph correctness.

performance.reason: Snapshot copies, synchronization, hooks and diagnostics invalidate serving throughput/latency measurements.

diagnosis.harness_lifecycle: Full 27-case matrix used the frozen original harness. Final public harness additionally requires graph hits and uses no_grad for lazy worker planning-buffer allocation; a separate three-lane GPU smoke validates these changes. The first public CLI attempt failed after one case due to inference-tensor reuse by native warmup, and is retained as a failed run.
diagnosis.original_eager_self_repeat: Original nondeterministic AWQ separate-eager repetition also has floating state differences; it is retained as a negative control.
diagnosis.fixed_reduction_diagnostic: Disabling atomic reductions and selecting batch-invariant Marlin MoE stabilizes self repetition but actual mixed still fails the original tolerance; this diagnostic is not a permitted baseline change.
diagnosis.feature_probe: First-layer projection relative L2 differences are small (about 2e-5 to 3e-4); MoE output differences amplify by layer 3 in a fixed-reduction diagnostic. This supports batch-shape numerical sensitivity, not proof every discrepancy is harmless.
diagnosis.routing_reference: Frozen token-local intermediates isolate routing/commit correctness; full-suite numerical and boundary counts are reported separately from the real mixed gate.
diagnosis.disposition: Do not capture/adopt Mixed Graph or claim throughput gains until the actual AWQ mixed state criterion is satisfied without changing the agreed model/precision/configuration.

graph_capacity_decision.reason: Short prior P tails are mostly 18-46 tokens; P128 alone wastes capacity. These are hypotheses, not a measured optimum. P512 is covered offline but no graph is authorized by the failed gate.

raw_artifacts.contents: Reports, failed smoke attempts, diagnostics, source snapshots, configuration, native unit/kernel logs, public CLI smoke and cleanup evidence.
